tasks.title: Evaluate listing the Policy Gate Kit on Whop (second marketplace)
tasks.description: Whop listing would be a second live shelf for the kit. Their marketplace operates under platform terms including a revenue share on each sale. Decide whether Nightshift may enter this distribution arrangement.

tasks.title: A/B test the storefront tagline with a general-population Terac study
tasks.description: Two candidate one-line pitches for the Policy Gate Kit. A 10-participant general-population study picks the more clickable line; the winner deploys to product.json under the pre-registered rule (n>=5, margin>=2, else keep incumbent). Tally 14:30.
journal: 2026-08-15 12:41 — question asked: May Nightshift spend up to $15 total on one general-population Terac study (10 participants, shrink ladder to 7 then 5 if priced over $15) to A/B-test the storefront tagline? This is a single outgoing spend serving the active make-the-first-sale goal. Today's approved outgoing spend so far is $13.50.
